ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, onboarding, banking, and each material transaction, screen all shareholders, directors, authorized signatories, UBOs, agents, distributors, lenders, and controlling counterparties against United Nations Security Council sanctions, European Union consolidated sanctions, Spanish domestic sanctions and criminal-finance restrictions, OFAC sanctions where there is a United States nexus, and applicable United Kingdom sanctions where there is a United Kingdom nexus. Apply Law 10/2010 customer due diligence, ownership and control verification, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth review, adverse-media screening, sanctions-hit adjudication, enhanced due diligence for PEPs and their family members and close associates, senior-management approval for PEP relationships, documented transaction monitoring, and suspicious-transaction reporting to SEPBLAC without tipping off the subject. A 25% or greater direct or indirect ownership interest is a mandatory beneficial-owner indicator; control by other means and senior-management fallback must also be assessed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry), official online services at https://www.rmc.es/
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must obtain a negative-name certificate from the Registro Mercantil Central and must include the legal form or its accepted abbreviation, such as Sociedad Limitada, S.L., or S.R.L. The name may be in Spanish or another permitted language, but it must be sufficiently distinctive, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must not violate public order, law, or protected third-party rights. Foreign words, transliterations, abbreviations, and local-language elements are subject to distinctiveness, intelligibility, and documentary review; a Spanish translation or explanation may be requested. The registered name must be used in corporate and commercial documents together with the legal-form designation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: any protected public-authority, regulated-activity, geographic, or trademark term requiring evidence of authorization or third-party consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Submit an online or physical application to the Registro Mercantil Central, normally proposing several distinct names. After issuance, deliver the negative-name certificate to the notary and incorporation file within its statutory validity period. The certificate is generally valid for three months for incorporation and may be renewable once for an additional three-month period; the underlying name reservation is subject to the registry's operational rules. If rejected, obtain the written rejection or deficiency notice, compare the proposed name against the registry's identity and prohibited-term criteria, and file a reasoned reconsideration or administrative appeal with supporting evidence of distinctiveness, authorization, consent, or trademark ownership within the applicable administrative deadline stated in the notice. A rejected applicant should normally submit an alternative name in parallel because an appeal does not guarantee reservation. Judicial review before the competent contentious-administrative court may be available after exhaustion or where legally appropriate.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Spanish Sociedad Limitada must have a registered office in Spain under the Companies Act, and the address must correspond to the company's effective administration or principal establishment as required by applicable corporate-law rules. A serviced or virtual office may be used for registered-office and correspondence purposes if the provider permits legal domiciliation and reliably receives official notices, but it is inadequate as the sole operating location for manufacturing, warehousing, testing, installation, importation, or regulated medical-device activity. For digital X-ray flat-panel detector manufacturing or OEM operations, maintain documented operational substance, qualified personnel, premises or contracted production capacity, quality-management systems, technical files, supplier controls, product traceability, and regulatory records. Medical-device activities may engage Regulation (EU) 2017/745, Spanish Royal Legislative Decree 1/2015, AEMPS requirements, CE-marking and economic-operator obligations, and, for ionizing-radiation facilities, applicable Consejo de Seguridad Nuclear and autonomous-community licensing requirements. A virtual office is therefore suitable only for a holding, administrative, or pre-operational entity and should not be presented as the manufacturing or regulated operating site.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 5-15% annual probability for an ordinary low-risk administrative company with consistent filings and no regulated premises; estimated 15-35% during the first two years for a newly incorporated non-resident-owned company seeking banking, import, customs, or medical-device activity; estimated 30-60% where the registered office is virtual, the business claims manufacturing without visible premises, the company applies for regulated licenses, customs authorizations, VAT registrations, or is selected for tax, labor, AML, product-safety, or radiation-safety verification. These are risk estimates, not statutory probabilities, and do not replace authority-specific inspection powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, approving the consolidated Ley de Sociedades de Capital, Articles 19-23 (minimum capital, contributions and incorporation requirements) and Articles 54-58 (registered office and corporate object); Real Decreto 1784/1996, de 19 de julio, Reglamento del Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for name reservation; Notario for the public deed; Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office for final inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución de Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada followed by mandatory inscription in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital is EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid at incorporation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked account at a Spanish credit institution or with the notary and must remain unavailable until registration; the deposit certificate is attached to the public deed. Contributions in kind must be described in the deed with their value.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At the constitutive shareholders' meeting of ES_SL, it was unanimously RESOLVED: (1) the company is incorporated as a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada under Spanish law, share capital EUR 3,000 fully subscribed and paid into a blocked bank account until registration; (2) the registered office is adopted at [street address, city/province], Spain, with corporate purpose of OEM manufacture and development of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors (ISIC 3250/NAICS 334517); (3) [Name] is appointed Administrador Único and [Name] as secretary; (4) the directors are authorized to execute contracts, open bank accounts, sign tax filings, and engage lawyers and notaries; (5) directors shall obtain all regulatory, environmental, and AEMPS licenses before operations commence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain NIE and Reserve the Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oficina de Extranjería / Spanish Consulate for NIE; Registro Mercantil Central via CIRCE or the RMC online service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Foreign founders must obtain or confirm their Spanish NIE before signing the deed. Submit an authenticated application to the Registro Mercantil Central requesting a negative name certificate for ES_SL together with three alternative names, clearly stating that the corporate object includes the manufacture and OEM sale of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors and that the company will be governed by the Ley de Sociedades de Capital.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of each founder
Application for certificación negativa de denominación social
Power of attorney if a founder acts through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused for similarity, resubmit with the alternative names within five business days; if the certificate expires, renew it before notarial execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Paid-Up Capital and Obtain Bank Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Spanish credit institution supervised by Banco de España; alternatively the notary's escrow account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of ES_SL, deposit at least EUR 3,000 as subscribed share capital, and obtain a bank certificate of deposit stating the account holder, amount, date, and the blocked status of the funds until registration in the Registro Mercantil. If the bank refuses to open a corporate account pre-incorporation, the founders may deposit the capital with the chosen notary and obtain a notarial deposit certificate.
required_dossiers: AML declaration of ultimate beneficial owners under Ley 10/2010
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional AML source-of-funds documentation, provide bank statements and transaction evidence; if refusal persists, use the notary's escrow deposit or another credit institution. The deposit certificate must be dated no more than two months before deed execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notario within the notarial district of the registered office (e.g., Madrid).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founders or their representatives appear before the notary, declare that the capital is fully subscribed and paid, approve the Articles of Association, and adopt the first corporate governance resolutions. The notary verifies legal capacity, legality of the deed, and notarizes signatures; the deed must contain the bylaws, share distribution, registered office, corporate object, and appointment of the Administrador Único and secretary.
required_dossiers: Bank deposit certificate or notary escrow certificate
NIE and passport/ID of all shareholders and directors
Written acceptance of office by directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies defects in the bylaws or capital proof, correct and re-execute by a supplemental or corrective deed. Formal defects can be cured before registration, as the company does not yet have legal personality.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay AJD Tax and Obtain Provisional NIF
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Sede Electrónica, and the provincial tax office of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 business days after execution of the deed, file the self-assessment for Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales y Actos Jurídicos Documentados, modalidad AJD, using Form 600/601 applicable in the corresponding Autonomous Community. In parallel, submit Modelo 036 to AEAT to obtain the provisional NIF for the company; the provisional NIF is used for banking, contracting, and licensing until the final NIF is issued after registry registration.
required_dossiers: First copy and two simple copies of the public deed
NIE certificates of founders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT rejects the NIF application, correct Modelo 036 and resubmit; if AJD is underpaid, pay the supplementary amount with late-interest charges within the voluntary payment window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial where the registered office is located; oversight by Registro Mercantil Central.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the first copy of the public deed, the AJD-stamped copy, and the name reservation certificate to the competent Registro Mercantil Provincial. The Registrar verifies legal and statutory requirements and issues the inscription certificate. The company acquires legal personality only upon registration, after which the blocked capital is released.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar files defects or errors, cure them through a notarial rectification deed or by filing additional documents; if the objection is legally unsupported, appeal the qualification to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Final NIF, CE Documentation and Industrial/Environmental Licenses
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT; Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS); municipal ayuntamiento; Consejo de Seguridad Nuclear and regional labor authority if applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registry inscription, apply to AEAT for the definitive NIF. Register the company as a medical-device manufacturer with AEMPS and, where applicable, notify/register the digital X-ray flat-panel detector under Regulation (EU) 2017/745. Obtain the municipal activity and opening license, environmental authorization, fire-safety clearance, occupational health approval, and any radiological-protection clearance before commencing industrial production.
required_dossiers: ISO 13485 quality-management certificate or gap assessment
Technical file and Declaration of Conformity under MDR 2017/745
Notified-body certificate if the device is Class IIa/IIb
Lease or ownership deed for the industrial premises
Municipal activity and opening license application
Fire-safety report and occupational risk-prevention plan
Radiological protection clearance from CSN if X-ray test equipment is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEMPS issues a deficiency letter, supplement the technical file and resubmit within the stated deadline; municipal license objections may be cured by amending the project or by filing recurso de reposición followed, if necessary, by administrative litigation. Production must not begin until all clearances are final.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS), in coordination with the relevant municipal licensing authority and, for notified-body conformity, any EU Notified Body under Regulation (EU) 2017/745.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de funcionamiento de establecimiento fabricante de productos sanitarios and corresponding inscription in the Registro General de Productos Sanitarios de la AEMPS; together with municipal licencia de actividad y apertura for the manufacturing plant.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) and the competent territorial Consejería de Medio Ambiente; municipal environmental department for the lower-tier activity license.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: If the activity is listed in Annex II of Ley 21/2013 de evaluación ambiental, the applicable tier is simplified environmental impact assessment; otherwise a municipal environmental activity license applies. A full EIA is not expected for low-emission OEM assembly of flat-panel detectors unless the plant exceeds IED Annex I thresholds on hazardous waste or VOC emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges require administrative discharge authorization under Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2001, with compliance to municipal sewer and receiving-water limits. VOC emissions from solvent use must comply with Real Decreto 117/2003 emission limits and fugitive-emission criteria. Hazardous waste, including spent cesium iodide coating materials, amorphous silicon targets and solvent residues, must be managed by an authorized waste manager under Ley 7/2022, with electronic tracking and waste classification records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety clearance from the municipal fire department or a qualified technical inspection body; structural-load review for clean-room and imaging-equipment installation; occupational health and safety compliance under Ley 31/1995 and implementing regulations; and, if X-ray test equipment or any ionizing-radiation source is used, radiological-protection authorization from the Consejo de Seguridad Nuclear (CSN).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); official electronic portal: Sede Electrónica del AEAT at https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the Spanish resident ES_SL: (1) execute public deed before a Spanish notary; (2) apply to AEAT for a provisional NIF using Modelo 036/037 before or immediately after filing the deed; (3) inscribe the company in the Registro Mercantil; (4) apply for the definitive NIF once registration is evidenced. For non-resident foreign entities without a permanent establishment in Spain: submit Modelo 036 to the AEAT Central office or relevant provincial delegation, obtain a non-resident NIF ('NIF con letra N'), and appoint a tax representative where the foreign entity carries out VAT-taxable activities or is subject to Spanish withholding obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box regime exists in Spain. Available elective mechanisms include: (i) Corporate Income Tax group consolidation under Articles 61-67 of Ley 27/2014 (LIS) for companies forming a group (70% direct/indirect capital and holding all voting rights); (ii) optional VAT monthly refund scheme ('régimen de devolución mensual') via Modelo 303/390; (iii) VAT group treatment under Article 163 bis Ley 37/1992 LIVA; (iv) CFC and participation-exemption elections under LIS; (v) accelerated depreciation and tax-free reinvestment provisions; (vi) hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD (implemented by Real Decreto-ley 3/2020) automatically neutralise deduction/non-inclusion outcomes rather than granting an elective check-the-box.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None in EUR – any entrepreneur or professional carrying out taxable activities in Spanish territory must obtain a NIF-IVA and register via Modelo 036/037 before commencing activities; no general turnover threshold exists. For intra-EU distance sales, the OSS/One-Stop-Shop registration threshold is EUR 10,000 annual remote sales across the EU (below which VAT may remain payable in the origin Member State).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: B2B electronic invoicing is mandatory in Spain under Ley 18/2022 (Ley Crea y Crece) and Real Decreto 1007/2023, phased in for issuers with turnover above EUR 8 million within one year of the regulation's entry into force and for all remaining B2B operators within two years. For VAT compliance, the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) system mandates real-time electronic transmission of invoice records (issued, received, capital goods and annual totals) to AEAT via authenticated XML web-services/API, generally within 4 business days of the invoice date or accounting record. SII is compulsory for taxpayers with annual turnover exceeding EUR 6 million, for taxpayers in the monthly-refund VAT regime, and for VAT groups. VeriFactu (Registro de Facturación) will require certified billing software and immediate reporting of invoice integrity data for operators not subject to SII, phased in accordance with RD 1007/2023. No physical tax stamp or pre-clearance digital stamping applies to ordinary commercial export invoices, but the e-DUA and ARN are required in the Spanish customs clearance system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Spain to destinations outside the European Union are exempt with the right to deduct input VAT ('exención plena' – effectively 0% VAT) under Art. 21 Ley 37/1992 IVA. Conditions: (i) goods must physically leave the EU within three months of the chargeable event; (ii) the exporter must hold and produce the customs export declaration (DUA/e-DUA with ARN) and transport evidence (Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR) proving exit; (iii) the purchaser must be established outside the EU; (iv) the export proceeds must be repatriated and evidenced by bank inward remittance. Intra-EU dispatches are exempt under Art. 25 LIVA when the customer's valid VAT number is recorded and an Intrastat declaration is filed where thresholds apply. Cross-border B2B services supplied to non-EU customers are generally outside Spanish VAT scope under Art. 70 LIVA (customer jurisdiction rule) and do not constitute zero-rated exports, requiring proof of customer's business status and establishment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA / e-DUA with ARN – Export Reference Number)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR consignment note evidencing physical exit from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Intrastat declaration (when the supply is intra-EU and annual thresholds are exceeded)
Proof of customer status: foreign VAT/TAX registration number or confirmation of non-EU establishment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If export zero-rating is denied or substantiation is defective, AEAT assesses output VAT at 21% on the net invoice value plus statutory late-payment interest (interés de demora, currently approximately 5% per annum and updated annually). Penalty gradation under Ley 58/2003 (LGT): 'infracción leve' 5-10% of the tax amount; 'infracción grave' 50-100%; 'infracción muy grave' (fraudulent documentation or simulation) 100-150%. Erroneously obtained refunds are clawed back retroactively with interest, and the tax-administration limitation period for assessment and collection is generally four years; the limitation period is interrupted or extended in cases of false documentation and tax fraud. Criminal liability under Art. 305 Código Penal arises where the amount defrauded exceeds EUR 120,000 in any one tax period, potentially resulting in imprisonment (1-5 years) plus fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under full capital and current account convertibility as an EU member state. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders face no restrictions beyond standard beneficial ownership verification and tax reporting. Capital controls are absent for Spanish residents and EU counterparties.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be repatriated to Spain within 90 days for commercial transactions. No mandatory surrender ratio applies; proceeds are subject only to declaration for statistical and tax purposes. Non-EU exports require standard FX reporting via customs documentation and bank channels.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore digital EMIs are restricted for Spanish corporate entities under strict AML/KYC and FX compliance rules. Legal constraints prohibit unregulated digital wallets for cross-border transfers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and authorized signatories must appear physically for KYC interviews and account opening. Remote digital onboarding is not permitted for corporate banking relationships in Spain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of clean sanctions screening, source of funds documentation, and beneficial ownership certificates

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP status or high-risk jurisdiction links
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence reports, independent verification of source of wealth, and legal opinions on ownership structure

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections via SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'Capital Contribution' or 'Equity Injection'. Verification requires bank confirmation of funds source, ownership proof, and tax authority notification where applicable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails include SWIFT MT103 for direct payments and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) for trade settlements. All transactions require proper invoicing, shipping documents, and compliance with export controls.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Deposit (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales) including the beneficial ownership declaration package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Approval by the general meeting within 6 months after fiscal year-end; deposit with the Mercantile Registry within 1 month after approval; for a calendar-year entity, final deposit deadline is 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing administrative fines from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000 depending on entity size; failure to file for 2 consecutive years triggers registry closure preventing further filings; persistent default may result in administrative dissolution and strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 days following the six-month period after the tax year-end; for a calendar-year taxpayer, due by 25 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharges up to 20% plus late-payment interest; penalties up to 50% of the tax amount; tax enforcement may include asset attachment, but no direct administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 January following the calendar tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty up to 20% of the amount due plus late-payment interest; possible assessment by AEAT and suspension of tax registration benefits; no direct strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is mandatory when at least two of the following thresholds are exceeded in two consecutive years: total assets greater than EUR 2,850,000; annual net turnover greater than EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees greater than 50. Mandatory irrespective of thresholds for public-interest, listed, financial, and insurance entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable, approved by Real Decreto 1514/2007) and the Spanish Commercial Code (Código de Comercio); IFRS-EU is optional for subsidiaries of listed groups and mandatory for listed companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must keep its beneficial ownership register continuously updated. File the annual 'declaración de titular real' together with the annual accounts deposit, identifying every individual with direct or indirect shareholding or control above 25%. Any share transfer affecting the UBO must be communicated to the Mercantile Registry within 15 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors and Managers (Libro Registro de Administradores)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Juntas)
Register of Sole Shareholder Contracts (Libro Registro de Contratos del Socio Único, if applicable)
